command: import subprocess,pathlib; print("Branch:",subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],text=True).strip()); print("HEAD:",subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()); subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True); names=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--modified","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines(); sizes=[(p,len(pathlib.Path(p).read_text().splitlines())) for p in names if p.endswith(".dart")]; assert all(n<=300 for p,n in sizes),sizes; print("Dart files checked:",len(sizes),"maximum lines:",max(n for p,n in sizes)); print("Status:"); subprocess.run(["git","status","--short","--untracked-files=all"],check=True)
